policy.condition_placement_update: The user approved natural questions that omit detailed conditions. This changes the earlier query-only condition requirement, not the scientific labels, methods, units, or admission rules. Every response must state the applicable conditions, including when the question omits them.
policy.structure_reference_location: Outside the user and assistant messages
policy.parameter_policy: Braced parameters are template variables for verified scalar values or composed property text, never structure placeholders. Replace every parameter before emitting a conversation.
policy.label_policy: Generate only tasks listed in the material's accepted_tasks. Read labels unchanged from its tasks object. Do not average, smooth, interpolate, or invent values.
policy.number_policy: Preserve the stored numerical values and units. Do not silently convert fractions to percentages or mass-normalized quantities to volume-normalized quantities.
policy.response_selection: Select a response only from the same template group as the query. Natural and explicit questions share the same scientifically qualified response bank.
policy.co2_without_pressure: Questions with no specified pressure belong exclusively to co2_five_points and receive the same five source pressure-uptake pairs at 298 K, never a randomly chosen single-pressure value.
policy.co2_single_point: The query always contains pressure_bar. Select it only from the five source pressures and use the uptake at that exact index. The response always states pure CO2, 298 K, the same pressure, and mol/kg.
policy.co2_curve: Use all five pairs from one accepted source curve. Do not describe them as a continuous isotherm, interpolate extra points, or call the final point saturation capacity.
policy.surface_area: Natural single-property questions still distinguish accessible from total area. Responses specify mass normalization, a nitrogen probe radius of 1.86 Å, and the area type. Total area includes accessible and inaccessible pores. Neither target is BET area.
policy.helium_void_fraction: Natural questions may ask about porosity or void fraction, but the response explicitly identifies the reported quantity as the helium void fraction at 298 K. It must not relabel this quantity as geometric void fraction.
policy.description: Require the description task to be accepted. Select a listed recipe only when every field is present in the accepted description fields and its scalar task is accepted. Use the same selected fields for requested_properties and property_sentences. Natural descriptions may omit the field list, but their answers remain restricted to that selected recipe.
policy.description_conditions: Helium temperature belongs only to the helium void fraction; nitrogen probe radius belongs only to the surface areas. Never apply those conditions indiscriminately to all properties.
policy.description_scope: Use only the five admitted pore-property tasks. Do not introduce CO2, density, formula, stability, synthesizability, applications, or mechanism explanations into this description bank.
policy.split_policy: All generated views of a structure keep the split in the checked master. This template bank does not allocate corpus counts or create new splits.

description_assembly.requested_properties: Look up each selected field in description_field_phrases. Join two phrases with ' and '; join three or more with commas and a final ', and '. Preserve the recipe order.
description_assembly.property_sentences: For each selected field, choose one response from that field's scalar group and fill value with its accepted label. Join the resulting complete sentences with single spaces, preserving the same field order. Fill the description response frame with that text.
description_assembly.record_metadata: Keep query_template_id, response_template_id, selected_fields, and every scalar response template ID outside the conversation text for traceability.
